If 'pages' means physical leaves (sheets), the book would have 150 leaves, and the digit count would be computed over leaf numbers instead.","counterconditions":[{"case":"If 'pages' means physical sheets, the answer is 150 sheets (300 faces)","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If numbering uses a non-decimal base, the digit-width boundaries shift and the page count changes","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If unnumbered blank pages are interspersed, the digit count no longer corresponds to a continuous sequence","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"The digit count is interpreted as the total length of a variable-length code (base-10 representation) applied to a sequence of integers from 1 to n. The inversion process identifies that the total 792 falls within the 3-digit code-length regime, and solving 9\u00d71 + 90\u00d72 + (n-99)\u00d73 = 792 gives n=300.
